doc: Coverage truthfulness matrix v0 — every shipped collection surface carries one of four honest tiers per supported platform, and every cell names an evidence pointer that a gate re-resolves against the shipped tree.
version_lock: Version lock: this matrix, docs/coverage-truthfulness.md and scripts/coverage-truth-check.mjs MUST evolve in one PR; the checker re-derives counters, vocabularies and platform facts from shipped source code on every run and fails on any drift — never against this file alone.

tier_semantics.FULL: the surface is collected on this platform and the shipped code declares no degradation path for it
tier_semantics.LIMITED: the surface is collected, but the shipped code names a concrete degradation path — fields can come back empty or unreadable
tier_semantics.MONITOR ONLY: the surface is observed and recorded only; Phase 0 expresses and audits, it never decides, blocks, or stops
tier_semantics.UNAVAILABLE: the platform does not implement this surface at all (a compile-time fact)

honesty: Every cell names at least one evidence pointer resolvable in the shipped tree; an unresolvable pointer fails the checker, so no cell can be hollow.

Platform differences are named per row and per cell. Blanket promises that smooth the per-OS hiding mechanisms into one undifferentiated guarantee are forbidden in every carrier; naming why each cell is not FULL is the product, and this matrix exists precisely to force that naming.
Counters are read from the shipped source at build time. A declared-but-unpopulated counter is recorded as declared-unset and never rendered as live coverage.
This matrix drives display and documentation only. While the enforcement-plane token reads none-in-observation-phase it feeds no decision, no rule engine, no policy evaluator, and no audit judgement.

unsupported_goos.note: Any other GOOS keeps the discovery package compiling but collects nothing; the snapshot returns an explicit unsupported error instead of pretending coverage.

evidence.token: process snapshot unsupported on this platform

no_cmdline.note: Rows whose command line came back empty at scan time, counted at scan and shipped as an event attribute every cycle.

hidden.note: Rows the OS actively hides from us, counted through the per-platform hiddenFromUs predicate wired into the collector.

no_cmdline_at.note: Declared for the unix hidden-by-OS seed, but no shipped production path increments it. Recorded as declared-unset: the census expects exactly one non-test occurrence (the declaration) and fails the day real code populates it without upgrading this row.

rows.covers: the enumeration of running processes feeding every other surface

linux.note: enumerated from /proc pid directories; the enumeration itself needs no privilege

darwin.note: enumerated from the full ps listing (all pids, all users)

windows.note: enumerated from the toolhelp process snapshot

rows.covers: the command-line text of each enumerated process

linux.note: other users' processes read back empty; kernel threads carry no cmdline

darwin.note: the ps args probe fails for kernel-protected privacy (or the process vanished)

evidence.token: kernel-level privacy or the process vanished

windows.note: protected processes cannot even be opened for the limited query rights; the cmdline read rides on that same handle

rows.covers: the honest per-cycle count of rows the OS hides from us

linux.note: per-platform predicate present with a true branch (empty or failing /proc read)

darwin.note: per-platform predicate present with a true branch (ps args probe failure)

windows.note: per-platform predicate present with a true branch (OpenProcess failure)

rows.covers: the honest per-cycle count of rows whose cmdline came back empty

linux.note: the empty-cmdline count ships; its hidden-by-OS sibling field is declared-unset, so accounting is not yet complete

evidence.token: hidden from us by the OS (unix)

darwin.note: same shipped counter, same declared-unset unix sibling

evidence.token: hidden from us by the OS (unix)

windows.note: the empty-cmdline count ships on every platform; the declared-unset sibling names the missing half

evidence.token: hidden from us by the OS (unix)

rows.covers: detection of Claude Code agent processes by shipped fingerprints

linux.note: fingerprints match command text; degraded wherever cmdline visibility degrades

darwin.note: same rule table, degraded by the darwin privacy path

windows.note: the shipped patterns also carry windows launcher suffixes, degraded by the windows handle path

rows.covers: detection of Codex agent processes by shipped fingerprints

linux.note: command-text fingerprints; degraded with cmdline visibility

darwin.note: same rule table, degraded by the darwin privacy path

windows.note: shipped patterns cover the windows executable suffix shapes; degraded by the windows handle path

rows.covers: detection of OpenClaw agent processes by shipped fingerprints

linux.note: command-text fingerprints; degraded with cmdline visibility

darwin.note: same rule table, degraded by the darwin privacy path

windows.note: the gateway launch-form pattern is command-text based; degraded by the windows handle path

rows.covers: detection of MCP servers (direct fingerprints, parent-chain lineage, orphaned siblings)

linux.note: direct rules read command text; the chain rule reads lineage — both bounded by the rows above

darwin.note: same two rules, degraded by the darwin privacy path

windows.note: same two rules, degraded by the windows handle path

rows.covers: observation of tool-call traffic through the local relay

linux.note: relay pairing observes completed records; nothing here decides or blocks

darwin.note: same observer shape; the nil-observer degradation is declared in the field comment

windows.note: same observer shape on the windows build

rows.covers: the closed capability vocabulary attached to classified events

linux.note: the vocabulary expresses capability use and never grants or enforces it

darwin.note: same closed table on every platform; input fields degrade with detection rows

windows.note: same closed table on every platform; input fields degrade with detection rows
